operational_failure_diagnosis.summary: Producer snapshot 39371247935 preserved the correct BOUNDED-NEGATIVE measurement but its provenance layer was broken in two ways: (1) the workflow-required machine-readable state fields cycle_status and evidence_tier were absent, so the producer validator (frontier-team.yml 'Validate Frontier producer delta and state') failed with exit 69; (2) the snapshot squash destroyed the freeze-before-compute commit ordering the charter names as the only valid freeze evidence (RULES.json and every computed artifact landed in one commit 53c9bb1; the cited freeze commits f08ca39/3fe5774 are not objects in the snapshot history), and the state file's run_history omitted the fixing run 39366203528 and misattributed its corrected numbers to 39355384602.

defects.effect: Workflow validator jq condition (.cycle_status // 'INITIALIZED') != 'INITIALIZED' and (.evidence_tier // 'UNTESTED') != '' evaluates false; producer exits 69; resilience dispatches an operational resume.
defects.fix: Added cycle_status='COMPLETED' and evidence_tier='REPRODUCED' (honest tier: deterministic byte-identical reproduction, no accepted audit gate artifact for this team) while retaining status/promotion_status.

defects.fix: Re-committed the freeze record (thresholds byte-identical; only a provenance-only snapshot_reaffirmation block added) as commit f33401a BEFORE the recomputed artifacts, restoring commit-time ordering within the snapshot. The limitation is recorded: the original 3fe5774/f08ca39 ordering cannot be reconstructed from the squashed snapshot.
